run_forward: run the forward pass of the UniVLG model on batched video inputs for training or inference
build_model_from_config: build a UniVLG model instance from a detectron2 configuration object
inference_video: inference video instance segmentation from classification logits and predicted masks
inference_video_semantic: inference video semantic segmentation from classification logits and predicted masks
inference_scannet_ghost: inference 3D instance segmentation on ScanNet ghost point cloud data
